name: scut-learning-team
description: Reviews classroom evidence and prepares cited quizzes in WorkBuddy.

displayDescription.en: Use selected course sources to prepare practice sheets and review conflicting statements with page and video references.
displayDescription.zh: 为学生核对课件与课堂原话，按主题编写带出处的练习题单，并检查引文、推导条件和证据缺口。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Prepare a practice sheet from one of my courses.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用我这门课的资料出一套带解析和出处的题。

quickPrompts.en: Prepare a practice sheet from one of my courses.
quickPrompts.zh: 用我这门课的资料出一套带解析和出处的题。

quickPrompts.en: Check a conflict between lecture captions and slides.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我核对一处字幕和课件的说法。

quickPrompts.en: Compare a classroom statement with a public reference.
quickPrompts.zh: 对照公开资料，看看老师这句话适用的条件。
